rationale: Strikes destroying a Strela-10 and AA mounts on Zmiinyi Island in late April corroborate the assessment that TB2s killed its exposed SHORAD.
The 103rd TDF Brigade crossing the Siverskyi Donets to take Ozerne on 3 September supports its working the Donets/Lyman flank from that date.
Ship specifications vs the sinking: context only.
B repeats the 21–30 June artillery fire on Zmiinyi Island from the same source, adding Vylkove, range and the nightly pontoon.
Baraniuk's breakout group being captured corroborates officials' admission that some marines were captured.
A strike on the Lvove ferry vs the site's coordinates: context only.
B gives the issue date (12 April 2022) and print run of the 'Russian warship' stamp A mentions.
B describes the column's movement without saying artillery led the tanks, so it neither confirms nor undercuts A's assessment.
The September withdrawal from Velyka Novosilka and UP's reading of the June deployment are different matters.
B gives the exact times of one of the Raptor kills that A summarises for May 2022.
IR cameras on the TB2s are context for, not evidence of, the May kills.
Attack attempts on 25 January and a 'largely destroyed' assessment on 6 February are different assertions.
The attack itself and the losses claimed in it are different quantities.
The pipeline route and a later statement about Ukrainian fire control over it are different assertions.
The 38th Marine Brigade taking part of the Kliushka solar farm supports its fighting on that axis; same source.
B repeats the 21–30 June artillery group against Zmiinyi Island, adding the gunner and OC South coordination.
The 60th Brigade's battalion joining the October drive on Zolota Balka and Dudchany fits the northern-sector break there.
B qualifies the October command change: unannounced and driven by the slow tempo; same source.
Number of civilians evacuated vs convoy departure: different facts.
The crossings in use vs their destruction after the withdrawal: different states and times.
The 3rd Battalion preparing ambushes at Brovary supports its presence at the ambush; shared Wikipedia source.
Overlapping garrison compositions (border guards, police) from the shared VOA source corroborate each other.
The Russian boat route at Dvorichna staying open supports A's identification of Dvorichna as a boat-crossing route; same source.
The fall of Illich vs Shoigu's surrender figure: different assertions.
Same Ivan Khurs attack location, 120–140 km north-east of the Bosphorus, from the same sources.
Same smoke trial and two radar-reflector barges at the Crimean Bridge from the same TWZ source, A dated more precisely.
BYPOL's damage claim implies the drones reached the A-50 at Machulishchy; same sources.
Both describe the Il-22M11 hit on 14 January 2024 heading for Anapa; shared Wikipedia source.
Same sinking of the Tsezar Kunikov about 4 km off Alupka on 14 February 2024; B adds coordinates.
Same Aksyonov statement on support 145 from the same TWZ report.
About 500 border guards and police moving to Azovstal fits their presence in the garrison.
The TB2 strike on a Serna under a still-working Tor illustrates the assessment; shared Naval News source.
B gives the date and details of the beacon evidence A describes; same source.
Both date the dam's destruction to 6 June 2023; both Wikipedia-based.
ISW and officials confirming the partial link-up corroborates the Wikipedia account of the group heading to Azov.
Different moments of the Stepove duel.
The 2021 delivery vs camera fit: different facts.
The Bradleys' manoeuvre vs the T-90M's smoke: different facts.
The Melitopol mayor's report is the basis for B's statement on columns along Mariupol–Berdiansk–Melitopol; same ISW report.
A volunteer's explanation of the surrender does not bear on Shoigu's figure.
